items.headline: 2 new proven top-timers in 90 days
items.detail: Wallet(s) that just crossed the ROI+capital bar by selling a top at profit — a burst means distribution is starting.
items.framing: 2 wallet(s) newly qualified as smart money in 90d (sold a top at ≥5× ROI). Low count = quiet market; a spike is the tell.
items.checkable: First crossing of the ROI+capital bar per wallet, from the sale history.

items.headline: Holders ~24% underwater — and still not selling
items.detail: MVRV 0.76: price is 24% below the crowd's avg on-chain cost basis ($0.478). Yet 55% of supply is in the longest-held tier — the float isn't moving.
items.framing: Maximum financial pain, minimal capitulation — conviction being tested and, so far, holding.
items.note: Describe the divergence, NOT a bottom call. "Not selling", not "buy".

items.headline: -84% below its all-time high
items.detail: Deepest drawdown on record was -95%; it has made new highs after every prior one so far.
items.framing: Deep drawdowns are the toll — it's paid them before (no recovery promise).
items.note: It's deep and unrecovered NOW; don't imply it always recovers.

items.headline: A whale added 2.13M SPX in 7 days
items.detail: 0xc048…c33d accumulated over the window, one of 3 whales net-buying.
items.framing: A large wallet accumulated 2.13M SPX in 7 days. Real, checkable buying by a big holder.
items.checkable: Net balance change on a watched wallet over the last week of transfers.

items.headline: SPX's MVRV 0.76 = 2th percentile of Bitcoin's history
items.detail: SPX's MVRV of 0.76 sits at the 2th percentile of Bitcoin's entire MVRV history — as cheap as BTC's generational bottoms.
items.framing: MVRV is unitless, so it's comparable: SPX today is at BTC's 2th percentile. BTC was only this cheap at major bottoms.
items.note: A position on BTC's map, not a date-match forecast.

items.headline: -86% below its long-run trend (Fire Sale band)
items.detail: Fair value for its age is $2.63; price sits -86% under it.
items.framing: Where today sits in the long power-law arc.

items.headline: 80% of all-time holders are gone — 92% of today's never sold to zero
items.detail: Of 27,229 wallets that ever held ≥5k SPX, 5,385 remain (80% churned). Yet 92% of CURRENT holders have never once sold to zero — survivorship.
items.framing: Enormous all-time churn, but the survivors are diamond-handed. The honest "who's still here" read.
items.note: Right-censoring: recent cohorts read high. "Gone" = fell below the 5k bar.

items.headline: NUPL -0.32 — capitulation
items.detail: Net unrealised profit/loss is -0.32 (from MVRV 0.76) — the market sits in the capitulation zone.
items.framing: Aggregate holder profitability. Below zero = the crowd is underwater, historically an accumulation zone.
items.note: A position read, not a signal.

items.headline: Smart money still net-selling (-19.6% over 12w)
items.detail: The 9-wallet cohort of proven top-timers (ROI ≥5×, still holding) holds 5.65M SPX. 4w -2.1% · 12w -19.6% · 26w -25%.
items.framing: Smart money hasn't started buying yet (-19.6% in 12w). Honest "not the bottom signal yet" read.
items.checkable: A recomputed cohort of wallets with realized ROI ≥5× that still hold ≥50k SPX; net flow of their combined balance.

items.headline: -1.2σ below its trend vs the alt market
items.detail: SPX ÷ the alt sector (ex-BTC/ETH/stables), detrended, sits 1.2σ below its own trend — cheap vs alts.
items.framing: Relative value vs the whole alt sector — -1.2σ cheap. SPX structurally outperforms alts, so this is deviation from ITS trend, not parity.
items.note: A relative-value position, not a signal.

items.headline: One wallet scooped 4 AEON in a single day
items.detail: 0xdc1e…7244 is the biggest net buyer of Project AEON over 30 days — 1.4 ETH ($3,349), well clear of the field.
items.framing: One wallet accumulated 4 AEON (~$3,349) on the market. Show the tornado / the city arcs — anyone can verify it.
items.checkable: Net marketplace buys minus sells per wallet over 30 days, from the public sale log.

items.headline: SOPR 0.889 — coins moving at a loss
items.detail: Spent-output profit ratio is 0.889: coins that moved on-chain realised a loss on average. Sustained <1 = capitulation, >1 = profit-taking.
items.framing: On-chain realised behaviour — loss-realisation (SOPR 0.889).
items.note: Only coins that MOVED; a behaviour read, not a signal.

items.headline: 140× at this age — vs Ethereum's 75×
items.detail: At the same age since launch (~3yr), SPX6900 is 140× vs Ethereum's 75× at the same point in its life.
items.framing: History rhymes: at this age SPX is 140×, Ethereum was 75×. A same-age comparison, not a forecast.
items.note: Both indexed to their own launch; close-based.

items.headline: 241,224 holders across 3 chains
items.detail: ETH 49,554 · Base 114,013 · Solana 77,657 = 241,224 wallets, +2.0% in ~30d. Base leads on headcount, ETH on value.
items.framing: The real reach: 241,224 wallets across three chains — most people on Base/Solana, most value on ETH.
items.note: Wallets, not people; Base/Solana are bridged.
